canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Talis Reshen: 18-year-old man, 161 cm (short), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: square compact face; small bright eyes and fine straight brows; broad low bridge, full lips; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: brown-chestnut, braids-twists-locs, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: mantle-short-cape, specifically a small mantle or short cape over an unarmored tunic and divided lower layers; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette plum-gray. Visible personal details: a narrow bracelet stack; one wide engraved hair cuff on one side, with no other hair or ear jewelry. Make the garment hem and outer silhouette the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: one thumb hooks lightly beneath the waist wrap while the other hand rests open. Include a palm-sized map roll only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
